signature: A rooted tree and a finite index set of items. Each item carries a positive weight and an ordered pair of vertices. Each edge splits the vertices into a far side and its complement, making a laminar nested family of subsets. An item is active on an edge exactly when its pair straddles the cut, signed by which endpoint is inside. Equivalently a matrix with entries in minus one, zero, plus one whose columns are signed indicator vectors of tree paths, post-multiplied by a diagonal weight matrix. The operation is rounding a point of the unit cube to one of its vertices so that a prescribed family of linear functionals is preserved as well as possible. The bounded quantity is a cut-wise maximum-norm deviation of a signed sum of item weights attenuated by rounding residuals, measured in units of the largest single item weight.
